fields.climate: tropical; rainy, warm, cloudy southwest monsoon (mid-May to September); dry, cool northeast monsoon (November to mid-March); southern isthmus always hot and humid
fields.terrain: central plain; Khorat Plateau in the east; mountains elsewhere
fields.hazards: land subsidence in Bangkok area resulting from the depletion of the water table; droughts
fields.resources: tin, rubber, natural gas, tungsten, tantalum, timber, lead, fish, gypsum, lignite, fluorite, arable land
fields.farm: sugarcane, rice, cassava, oil palm fruit, maize, rubber, tropical fruits, chicken, mangoes/guavas, fruits
fields.exports: machine parts, integrated circuits, trucks, cars, broadcasting equipment
fields.industries: tourism, textiles and garments, agricultural processing, beverages, tobacco, cement, light manufacturing such as jewelry and electric appliances, computers and parts, integrated circuits, furniture…
fields.languages: Thai (official) only 90.7%, Thai and other languages 6.4%, only other languages 2.9% (includes Malay, Burmese); English is a secondary language among the elite
fields.religions: Buddhist 92.5%, Muslim 5.4%, Christian 1.2%, other 0.9% (includes animist, Confucian, Hindu, Jewish, Sikh, and Taoist)
fields.legal: civil law system with common law influences
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; all men register at 17 years of age and are subject to selective compulsory military service at 21…
